{#1}Charge{/#1} will move the orc next to your brother and possibly stun him if not repelled (has a range of 3 tiles and the height level difference can't be higher than 1). The chance to stun starts at 100% and is reduced by the amount of Melee Defense from {#2}shields{/#2} and Shieldwall.
units.zh: {#1}冲锋{/#1}使兽人移动至佣兵身旁；若未被逼退，还可能将其撞晕。技能距离为 3 格，高度差不能超过 1 层。眩晕概率从 100% 起算，再减去{#2}盾牌{/#2}及盾墙提供的近战防御。

units.source: {#1}Charm{/#1} will attempt to mindcontrol 1 of your brothers for 2 turns - Your chance to resist being charmed is your {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} - 35. That means with 35 or less you will always be charmed and with 130 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} you have a 95% chance to resist. (95% is the max) - Standing right next to the hexe makes resisting charm more difficult. (-40 instead of -35) - You get 2 chances to resist the charm effect - The status ends on the start of your turn if the hexe is dead (has a range of 8 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}魅惑{/#1}尝试控制 1 名佣兵，持续 2 回合。抵抗概率等于意志{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} - 35，因此意志为 35 或更低时必定被魅惑，达到 130 意志{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}时有 95% 概率抵抗，上限也是 95%。若紧挨女巫，抵抗会更困难，修正由 -35 变为 -40。每次魅惑有 2 次抵抗机会；若女巫已死亡，魅惑会在被控制佣兵回合开始时解除。技能距离为 8 格。

units.source: {#1}Devour{/#1} instantly kills the brother if you end your turn next to the mouth
units.zh: {#1}吞噬{/#1}：若佣兵在巨口旁结束回合，就会被立即杀死。

{#1}Ensnare:{/#1} You are rooted, can't move, unable to use skills and are dragged towards its maw - You can be dragged by up to 6 tiles - Your chance to break free is your {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} + 10 for each previous try - You also lose 10 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} at the end of your turn - You have {#8}-100{/#8} {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} while you are rooted - Removing the ensnare will damage the tentacle (has a range of 2 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}缠缚：{/#1}目标被定身，无法移动或使用技能，并被拖向巨口，最多可拖动 6 格。挣脱概率以近战命中{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}为基础，每次此前的尝试再 +10。被缠缚时，回合结束会损失 10 点生命值{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}，先攻受到 {#8}-100{/#8} 惩罚{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9}。挣脱会伤害触手。技能距离为 2 格。

units.source: {#1}Fire Mortar{/#1} marks an area of 7 tiles for impact and 1 turn later does 20-40{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 70% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 20% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} in that area, anyone hit becomes {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Shellshocked{/#14}, never misses, causes a morale check and can fire every 2 turns if reloaded by an {#15}Engineer{/#15} (has a range of 3-999 tiles)
{#1}Fling Back{/#1} will toss the target behind the {#2}unhold{/#2}, target gets {#3}10{/#3} {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} and suffers falling damage

{#1}Gore{/#1} does 100-130 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 75% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has knockback and {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}staggers{/#14} the target on hit (has a range of 3 to 6 tiles (except on turn 1 it has a range of 3 to 10 tiles))
{#1}Grow Shield{/#1} creates a new shield after the old one was broken
units.zh: {#1}再生木盾{/#1}会在原盾牌被击碎后生成一面新盾牌。

units.source: {#1}Gruesome Feast{/#1} Eats a dead body, grows in size (if possible), improves its morale, removes all injuries and heals up to max {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} (the nachzehrer has to be on the same tile as the dead body)
units.zh: {#1}血腥盛宴{/#1}吞食尸体，在能够成长时增大体型，提高士气，移除所有伤势，并将生命值{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}恢复至上限。食尸鬼必须与尸体位于同一地块。

units.source: {#1}Hex{/#1} curses one of your brothers for 2 turns (you will take the same damage as the hexe) - The damage will ignore your armor - The hex can't be resisted and a brother can't have more than 1 hex on him at the same time (has a range of 8 tiles and a cooldown of 1 or 2 turns)
units.zh: {#1}咒缚{/#1}诅咒一名佣兵，持续 2 回合；女巫受到的伤害会以无视护甲的方式同步施加给这名佣兵。咒缚无法抵抗，同一名佣兵同时最多受到 1 个咒缚。技能距离为 8 格，冷却为 1 或 2 回合。

units.source: {#1}Horrific Scream{/#1} will cause resolve-checks with a range of 3 tiles
units.zh: {#1}恐怖尖啸{/#1}会使 3 格范围内的目标进行意志检定。

units.source: {#1}Horror{/#1} will cause separate resolve checks that can lower the morale (with {#2}-15{/#2}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}) and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Horrify{/#9} targets for one turn, making them unable to act (with {#10}-5{/#10}{#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11}) (targets an area of 7 tiles and has a range of 7 tiles)

{#1}Line Breaker{/#1} will knock a target 1 tile back, never misses and the target suffers {#2}10{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, removes {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Shieldwall{/#9}, {#10}{#11}{#12/}{/#11}{/#10} {#13}Spearwall{/#13}, {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Riposte{/#17} when applied (has a range of 1 tile)

{#1}Miasma{/#1} does direct 5-10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage each turn to a living unit that finishes its turn standing in it (targets an area of 7 tiles, has a range of 8 tiles and lasts for 3 turns on the ground)
units.zh: {#1}瘴气{/#1}每回合对在其中结束回合的活体单位直接造成 5-10 点生命值伤害{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}。作用区域覆盖 7 格，技能距离为 8 格，地面瘴气持续 3 回合。

units.source: {#1}Move Tail{/#1} Teleports the tail right next to the body (has unlimited range)
units.zh: {#1}移动尾部{/#1}将尾部传送至身体旁边，距离不限。

units.source: {#1}Move Tentacle{/#1} teleports the tentacle to another tile (has a range of 8 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}移动触手{/#1}将触手传送至另一地块，距离为 8 格。

units.source: {#1}Nightmare{/#1} does 25 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage - 25% of your current {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, will at least do 5 {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} damage, ignores armor, never misses, can only be used on sleeping brothers and will wake them up (has a range of 2 tiles)

{#1}Raise Undead{/#1} will raise any type of wiedergangers and skeletons (with 50% of their {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}) and any dead humans; cannot be used if the target was decapitated or its head was smashed, or if someone is standing on the corpse; can be used 2 times a turn (has unlimited range)
units.zh: {#1}唤醒亡者{/#1}可复活各类行尸、骷髅及死去的人类，复活后拥有 50% 生命值{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}。目标被斩首、头部被击碎，或尸体上站有其他单位时无法使用。每回合可使用 2 次，距离不限。

units.source: {#1}Root{/#1} will root up to 7 targets, a rooted target can't move, has {#2}-35%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, {#6}-35%{/#6} {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7}, {#10}-35%{/#10} {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} and your chance to break free is your {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} -10 points with + 10 for each failed attempt (has a range of 8 tiles)

{#1}Sleep{/#1} attempts to put a brother to sleep, sleep is like a stun but the brother can be woken up by other brothers or rally the troops skill, can be resisted with a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} check, after 3 turns the brother will wake up on his own (has a range of 2 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}沉睡{/#1}尝试使一名佣兵睡着。睡眠类似眩晕，但其他佣兵或重振士气技能可以将其唤醒。目标可通过意志{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}检定抵抗，并会在 3 回合后自行醒来。技能距离为 2 格。

units.source: {#1}Spirit Walk{/#1} teleports the ijirok, turns surrounding tiles to snow tiles and {#2}chills{/#2} the brothers next to the teleport (has a range of 1 to 30 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}灵体漫步{/#1}使伊吉罗克传送，将周围地块变为雪地，并使传送位置附近的佣兵{#2}冻寒{/#2}。技能距离为 1 至 30 格。

units.source: {#1}Swallow Whole{/#1} Devours a brother and removes him from the battle until the nachzehrer has died - The brother takes 10-20 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage, but will at least emerge with 5 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} remaining - You can't straight up die from being devoured
units.zh: {#1}囫囵吞食{/#1}吞下一名佣兵，使其暂时离开战场，直到食尸鬼死亡。佣兵会受到 10-20 点生命值伤害{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，但脱困时至少保留 5 点生命值{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}；吞食本身不会直接致死。

units.source: {#1}Tail Slam Sweep{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 3 targets next to each other, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn

{#1}Tail Slam Thresh{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 6 targets right next to the tail, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn
{#1}Unstoppable Charge{/#1} will {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}stun{/#5} and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}stagger{/#9} the target (has a range of 3 tiles)

{#1}Warcry{/#1} bolsters the {#2}Morale{/#2} and reduces the accumulated {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} Fatigue of nearby allies, weakens the {#6}Morale{/#6} of nearby brothers (more likely to work the closer they are to the {#7}Orc Warlord{/#7})
units.zh: {#1}战吼{/#1}提高附近友军的{#2}士气{/#2}，减少其累积的{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}疲劳，同时降低附近佣兵的{#6}士气{/#6}。佣兵越靠近{#7}兽人军阀{/#7}，受影响的概率越高。

units.source: {#1}Weave Web{/#1} will throw a web on enemies, preventing movement, reducing their {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} and {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} by 50% (has a cooldown of 3 turns)
{#1}Whip{/#1} will set the morale of one goblin to "confident", if the goblin was fleeing it will only be set to "steady" (has a range of 5 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}鞭击{/#1}将一名地精的士气设为“斗志昂扬”；若其原本正在溃逃，则只恢复至“镇定”。技能距离为 5 格。

units.source: {#1}Wolf Bite{/#1} does 20-40 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 40% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 15% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} ({#11}Goblin Wolfriders{/#11} can use it only once per turn and it costs 0 AP for them)
Orc Weapons require 5 additional fatigue per skill use for humans.
units.zh: 人类使用兽人武器时，每次施放技能都额外积累 5 点疲劳。

units.source: {#1}Corpse Explosion{/#1} makes a corpse or a {#2}Flesh Cradle{/#2} explode, dealing 25-50{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} to anyone adjacent and 30-60{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} to the entity standing on the corpse. Damage is dealt to the body with 75% {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} and 20% {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} and ignores Nimble. Creates miasma on affected tiles. Spell range is 1-99 tiles.
{#1}Flesh Pull{/#1} moves a brother 2 tiles towards a corpse, a {#2}Flesh Cradle{/#2} or any {#3}Flesh Golem{/#3}, and {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}staggers{/#7} him. Spell range is 1-99 tiles.

{#1}Corpse Hurl{/#1} is a ranged attack. Does 55-65 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 110% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} if hits. Additionally does 20-40 {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} with 50% {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} and 25% {#17}{#18}{#19/}{/#18}{/#17}, ignoring Nimble, in a 7 tiles area where the corpse landed, even if the attack misses. Creates a corpse and can be used without any corpses nearby. Range is 4 tiles, 5 with height advantage.

{#1}Flurry{/#1} hits adjacent enemies, starting from the tile to the north and then going clockwise. It can loop and hit same enemies again. After a total of 6 attacks it ends. Each hit does 40-65 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 65% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 20% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}.
